concept.title: Milestones and their criteria
concept.shortdesc: A milestone marks a point the project must reach. Each has criteria: a measure of the project's artifacts and the percentage it must reach. On the chart, a milestone's name opens it beside the chart, as a task's does, and the open mark after its name opens it in full, over the page.

conbody.p: A milestone can also wait for tasks. In its panel, Waits for lists them: choose one under Wait for a task…, or drag a link from the + at the end of a task's bar onto the milestone's diamond. The chart draws a line from each to the milestone's date. Its date is says how the date is set. Fixed keeps the date you give it, and a task that finishes after it turns its line red and dashed and is flagged in the panel. By the plan puts the milestone on the day the last task it waits for finishes, and it moves when they do; until one is scheduled it keeps its own date. A release's milestone can wait for tasks too, but its date is always its release's. A task with sub-tasks cannot be waited for: choose the sub-task.

strow.stentry: User needs that at least one requirement derives from
Requirements whose review status is approved
Requirements that a design item satisfies
Requirements that a test case verifies
Test cases whose latest result is a pass
Hazards that a design item mitigates
Tasks due by the milestone's date that are in Done
Tasks assigned to the milestone that are in Done

conbody.p: Add milestone starts from a preset, such as Definition complete (user needs addressed: 100%), which you can change: give the milestone a name, a date, and any criteria with their targets. An early milestone might ask only that every user need is addressed; a later one that 80% of requirements are verified.

A milestone's progress is how far its criteria have come toward their targets, averaged. It is met when every criterion has reached its target, and late when its date has passed and it is not met. Select a milestone to see each criterion's figure and the count behind it, and to edit or delete it. A milestone with no criteria shows no progress.
